title: Final Fantasy Tactice Ivalice Chronicles [PS5] [Switch] $49.00 @JB Hi Fi, Elden Ring Nightreign [PS5] $19.00, Suikoden [PS5] $40
body:
Deal: Final Fantasy Tactice Ivalice Chronicles [PS5] [Switch] $49.00 @JB Hi Fi, Elden Ring Nightreign [PS5] $19.00, Suikoden [PS5] $40

[justtoreply] Does suikoden have a good story by today's standards?
I want to avoid the kind of disappointment I had with the revered Ys.
[Flintz] Main story is simple, it's just war. But the execution and character development are top tier. IMO suikoden 2 is the better one, but made much better after playing the first
[kensaiD] Which Ys did you start with by chance? Because, in my opinion, VIII is the only one with a story I'd say is good.
Otherwise the franchise is just about the fun combat and banging soundtracks.
[dreamstation] Bunch of other games discounted too like Stalker 2 down to $29 and Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 for $19 on PS5.
[Fappo] These are definitely nice to have. They make the terrible battery life more bearable.
[dreamstation] Sorry I edited my post but yes the dual sense charging station is down to $29.
https://www.jbhifi.com.au/products/ps5-playstation-5-dualsen…
[Fappo] All good
Stalker 2 for $29 is a good buy. I might pick that up and add it to the pile of shame.
[mangobango] Thanks OP, nabbed a copy of FF Tactics.
Resonance is so good it's gotten me back on the FF train lol.
